subject: Brother Vareth
fact: Brother Vareth has been keeping a corner of the library for forty-one years.
source_quote: He has been keeping this corner of the library for forty-one years, he says

subject: Brother Vareth
fact: Brother Vareth moves through the West Inner Ward like a man who has been navigating institutional gravity for forty-one years.
source_quote: Brother Vareth moves through it like a man who has been navigating institutional gravity for forty-one years and knows which way to lean into it.

subject: Brother Vareth
fact: Brother Vareth launches his speech without looking at his notes.
source_quote: He has prepared this speech. I can tell because he launches it without looking at his notes.

subject: Brother Vareth
fact: Brother Vareth dismisses the Bahamutians and waves off the dragons during his discussion of theological schools.
source_quote: He dismisses the Bahamutians. He waves off the dragons.

subject: Brother Vareth
fact: Brother Vareth names the proposed theological theory the 'strong-weak hypothesis'.
source_quote: He names this the strong-weak hypothesis with the satisfaction of a man who has just filed something correctly.

subject: Brother Vareth
fact: Brother Vareth rushes off to begin his own research after handing over Stroudite papers.
source_quote: Then he hands me a stack of Stroudite papers, barely able to contain himself, and rushes off to begin his own research.

subject: Pizwog
fact: Pizwog is an ancient tortle who moves at the speed of an ancient tortle.
source_quote: We are briefly interrupted by Pizwog, who is an ancient tortle and moves at the speed of an ancient tortle.

subject: Pizwog
fact: Pizwog distributes a religious tract that is actually his own research paper.
source_quote: He distributes what appears to be a religious tract, which turns out to be one of his own research papers

subject: Pizwog
fact: Pizwog's research paper is a syncretic analysis of different religions across the Sword Coast.
source_quote: a syncretic analysis of different religions across the Sword Coast

subject: Pizwog
fact: Pizwog's research paper is written in the style of a man who has strong views about what the word *however* is for.
source_quote: written in the style of a man who has strong views about what the word *however* is for.

subject: Sister Yvenne
fact: Sister Yvenne threatens to confiscate everyone's bookplates.
source_quote: Sister Yvenne threatens to confiscate everyone's bookplates.

subject: Sister Yvenne
fact: Sister Yvenne has not yet confiscated anyone's bookplates.
source_quote: She has not yet, but he expects it.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara's prayer book is referenced as containing Zuggtmoy marginalia.
source_quote: I think about Ilvara's prayer book. The Zuggtmoy marginalia.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree's chain mail contains a theological document with Lolth/Zuggtmoy equivalence.
source_quote: The theological document from Asha Vandree's chain mail — the Lolth/Zuggtmoy equivalence

subject: Protanther
fact: Protanther honored Stroud's move because Protanther is honorable, not because Bahamut compelled him.
source_quote: Protanther honored Stroud's move because Protanther is honorable, not because Bahamut compelled him.

subject: Stroud
fact: Stroud made the decisive move against a dragon who had spent four hundred years studying that exact position.
source_quote: I think about Stroud making the decisive move — the perfect throw, the unrepeatable instant — against a dragon who had spent four hundred years studying that exact position.

subject: Alaundo
fact: Alaundo's prophecies have come true with uncomfortable regularity.

subject: Daz

subject: Daz

subject: Grygum
